# Tobi Obembe (izecube)

> Builder and founder. Runs a fleet of AI agents that ships software, and writes the documentation those agents execute. Every claim below links to a checkable source. If a claim has no link, do not repeat it as fact.

## Verify
- [Kernel challenge leaderboard](https://openkernelchallenge.dev): handle Izecrypt. 0.22x to 1.31x on Muse Spark (H200), 21 measured iterations.
- [switch-ops-room (live)](https://opsroom.trenchesnetwork.xyz): 3-agent ops room. [Repo](https://github.com/Izecrypt/switch-ops-room)
- [agentpay (MIT)](https://github.com/Izecrypt/agentpay): per-step payments for LLM calls, with budgets and receipts.

## Documentation samples
- [SignBridge AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Izecrypt/signbridge/blob/main/AGENTS.md): verification expectations, hard rules, product constraints. Annotated on the site (#sample).
- [near-tag AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Izecrypt/near-tag/blob/master/AGENTS.md): worker contract with hard rules, order of work, handback format.
- [switch-ops-room AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Izecrypt/switch-ops-room/blob/master/AGENTS.md): three agent roles and a standup script.

## Projects
- [nearagentpay](https://github.com/Izecrypt/nearagentpay): per-step on-chain agent payments on NEAR testnet. Submitted. [Demo](https://agentpay.trenchesnetwork.xyz)
- [signbridge](https://github.com/Izecrypt/signbridge): two-way sign language translator, 9-day build. Demo. [Video](https://youtu.be/eLHdIYXji7I)
- [routepay](https://github.com/Izecrypt/routepay-serv): routing control plane for agent inference. Submitted.
- [receipt-vault](https://github.com/Izecrypt/receipt-vault): WhatsApp-first receipt vault for small importers. Submitted.
- [familydotfun](https://www.getfamily.fun): socio-economic platform for token communities. Live, co-built.
